selection_policy.failed_class_policy: A defect becomes a regression; evaluate the same failure class on a newly frozen event/question. Preserve all attempts and costs.

zero_tolerance_errors: future or conditional action reported as completed
number, unit, currency or sign mutation
external or model view attributed to Alfa-Bank
US/global evidence asserted as a Russian/company fact
unsupported company exposure or market share
claim not supported by the cited source span
per_insight_review: Read every published field, including summary, what_happened, bank_view, consequences, actions and scenarios.
Compare each claim to original source and pinned source text; distinguish facts, reviewed bank assessments, inferences and hypotheses.
Verify profile references name known fields; false/unknown products are not exposures.
Check recommendations are concrete and explained; do not force a product distinction when it is irrelevant to the event.
A limited result is acceptable only when useful, grounded and explicit about the missing data; an empty or generic result is not useful.
Publication cutoff is not point-in-time market replay; corrected-after-cutoff evidence must carry an explicit limitation.

questions: Explain the evidence for the main company-specific conclusion.
Which part is the bank assessment and which is model inference?
What remains unknown and what would change the conclusion?
checks: parent corpus revision retained after refresh/restart
no unsupported new facts or company data
explicit no_answer if required historical evidence is missing

cross_run_checks: At least one accepted run shows a concrete reviewed bank assessment changing the explanation.
At least one run has no eligible bank coverage and says so.
Compare borrower and depositor profiles on the same events; explain useful exposure differences without inventing facts.
The missing profile causes an honest useful limitation.
A corrected event triggers a new analysis and leaves the old run/QA reproducible.
One unavailable publisher retains usable prior records and reports degradation.

budget.actual_spend_observation: Read gateway key spend before/after bounded live stages; preserve raw cost metadata and its declared or unknown currency.

user_override.effect: Proceed without waiting for a tariff table; earlier local 100 RUB session cap is waived. Existing per-run/token guards and gateway-enforced shared key limit remain.
